(Fatwa: 186/176=D/1429) You may get ordinary harm from any of your close and trusted persons, but with your benevolence he will finally turn obliged to you. This is the interpretation. But, you should not get into investigation and should not think ill of anyone, rather mind your business, be mindful of salah and pray Allah for comfort in both the worlds.
